title: Bellerophon's descendants
intro: Success gives way to isolation and family loss. Glaucus' genealogy reveals an unexpected bond with Diomedes.

notes.text: ἀνέρχομαι pres ptc dat sg, returning; δόλος, trap / trick; ὑφαίνω, weave: unaugmented 3sg impf, “devised.”
Close-knit / cunning; literal density becomes strategic craft.
κρίνω, choose: aor ptc nom sg; φώς, man / warrior: acc pl.
ἵζω, set / station: 3sg aor; λόχος, ambush / ambushing party.
οἶκονδε, homeward; νέομαι, return: unaugmented 3pl impf, negated.
καταπέφνω, kill: reduplicated 3sg 2aor; Bellerophon kills the whole ambush.
γόνος, offspring; ἠΰς, noble: acc sg; ἐόντα = ὄντα. Recognizes him as the noble offspring of a god.
αὐτοῦ, there; κατερύκω, keep / detain: unaugmented 3sg impf. Now hospitable, not hostile detention.
δίδωμι unaugmented 3sg impf; ἥν possessive, his own; daughter given in marriage.
βασιληΐς, royal: gen fem sg; ἥμισυ, half, + partitive gen; share of royal prerogatives / honour.
τέμενος, allotted estate, literally cut-off land; τέμνω unaugmented 3pl 2aor; ἔξοχος, outstanding / choice.
φυταλιή, orchard / planted land; ἄρουρα, arable land: gen of contents / composition.
νέμω, enjoy / occupy: 3sg pres mid opt, purpose.
παραλέγομαι, lie beside: 3sg aor mid; μητίετα, counsellor / wise, epic nom in -α. Zeus fathers Sarpedon by Laodameia.
Godlike; bronze-armoured warrior: acc sg with Sarpedon, wounded in Book V.
κεῖνος, Bellerophon; ἀπεχθάνομαι 3sg 2aor mid, became hated. The reason is not supplied here.
κὰπ = κατά before π; οἶος, alone; ἀλάομαι, wander: unaugmented 3sg impf mid. Ἀλήϊον, Aleian plain, echoes wandering.
ὅν possessive, his own; κατέδω, consume: pres ptc, “eating his heart out.”
πάτος, path / track: acc sg; ἀλεείνω, avoid: pres ptc; shunning human company.
ἆτος, insatiate, + gen of war; μάρναμαι, fight: pres ptc acc sg with Isander.
τήν, Laodameia; χολόω, anger: aor mid ptc nom fem sg; χρυσήνιος, golden-reined, Artemis.
κτείνω, kill: 3sg root aor act, short κτα- stem.
τίκτω 3sg impf, “Hippolochus begot me”; finally identifies this speaker, Glaucus, as Bellerophon's grandson.
ἐπιτέλλω, enjoin: 3sg impf; πόλλα adverbial, earnestly / repeatedly.
ἀριστεύω, excel: pres inf; ὑπείροχος, pre-eminent, + gen; ἔμμεναι = εἶναι. His father's charge: excel beyond the others.
αἰσχύνω, shame: epic pres inf -έμεν = -ειν; do not disgrace the ancestral stock.
εὔχομαι, claim / avow here; gen of descent with εἶναι, “I claim this lineage and blood.”
γηθέω, rejoice: 3sg aor; Diomedes recognizes the family connection.
καταπήγνυμι, plant firmly: 3sg aor; χθών dat sg; πουλυβότειρα, feeding many, earth's epithet.
μειλίχιος, gentle / soothing: dat neut pl, words understood; ποιμήν, shepherd: acc sg, leader of the host.
